confirm.title: Add {model}
confirm.description: Roundhouse found {model} ({device_id}). Choose the URL path of its dashboard. An existing dashboard with this path is used as it is.

data_description.slug: Lowercase letters, digits, and at least one hyphen.

error.invalid_slug: Use lowercase letters and digits with at least one hyphen, for example tender-panel.

abort.discovery_only: Roundhouse devices are discovered over MQTT. Power on the device and wait for it to be announced.
abort.not_roundhouse: The message is not a Roundhouse announce.
abort.invalid_profile: The device profile is not usable: {detail}. See Repairs.

data_description.snapshot_view: View a sleeping device refreshes. Leave empty for the first view.
data_description.presence_grace_hours: How long an offline device still counts as home.

profile_invalid.title: Device {device} sent an unusable profile
profile_invalid.description: Roundhouse cannot use the profile of {device}: {detail}. It publishes only the contract version to this device until the profile is fixed.

contract_mismatch.title: Device {device} uses another contract version
contract_mismatch.description: The contract versions do not match ({detail}). Update Roundhouse or the device. Roundhouse publishes only the contract version to this device until they match.

mqtt_birth_disabled.title: The MQTT birth message is disabled
mqtt_birth_disabled.description: Devices learn that Home Assistant is up from the birth message on homeassistant/status. Enable it in the MQTT integration options.
